novelty.justification: The claim proposes that “velocity and direction of this drift across turns” forecast jailbreaks and that a per-turn “restoring force” can re-anchor residual representations, so its novelty route is a trajectory-level measurement and feedback mechanism rather than a new attack setting. Searches around “multi-turn jailbreak representation drift velocity prediction,” “trajectory internal activations jailbreak early warning,” and “dynamic activation steering restoring force safety” identify Aggarwal et al. (2025), which already reports increasingly benign representations across Crescendo turns, and THRD (2026), which already models temporal risk accumulation and trends, but neither retrieved work uses harmfulness-representation velocity for turns-ahead forecasting or proportional activation feedback to an initial anchor. The step is therefore a non-trivial natural extension that changes the unit of analysis from turn states to trajectories and combines prediction with closed-loop steering, but taking a derivative of known drift and applying a standard proportional correction is not itself a new core interpretability or control paradigm.
